headers.description: Headers added to every answer of this endpoint. They win over the backend's common headers.

delayMs.description: Wait this long before answering. It wins over every other delay setting.

body.description: Sent as the JSON body instead of the normal response.

description.description: What the response is (from an imported API file).

schema.description: JSON Schema of this response body (from an imported API file). Documentation only.

additionalProperties.title: Scenario
additionalProperties.description: A canned response, picked with the x-tempo-scenario header or the admin API.

importedFrom.description: Fingerprint of the endpoint as an API file import made it. A different fingerprint now means someone edited it.

source.description: `collections`: types, queries, mutations and subscriptions generated from the collections. `sdl`: the schema in `sdl`.

sdl.description: The schema. With `source: "collections"` it extends the generated one (`extend type Query { hello: String }`).

collections.description: Only these collections are exposed (default: all).

hiddenFields.description: Fields left out of the generated types, as `collection.field`. Fields a crud endpoint hides are left out too.

static.description: Answer with this value. `{{args.x}}` reads an argument of the field.

handler.description: Answer with a handler file. It gets `ctx.req.body = { field, args, parent }` and returns the value.

event.description: For a subscription field: stream the payloads of this event.

maxDepth.description: The deepest nesting a query may have (introspection is not counted).

maxFields.description: The most fields a query may select, fragments counted every time they are used.

maxQueryBytes.description: The longest query text accepted (413 beyond).

introspection.description: Answer `__schema` and `__type` (on by default: this is a mock).

requireAuth.description: Operations that need a signed-in user even when the endpoint is open. `auth: "bearer"` protects every operation.

maxOperationsPerConnection.description: Most operations a subscriptions connection runs at once.

initTimeoutMs.description: A subscriptions connection that sends no connection_init within this time is closed with 4408.

maxConnections.description: The most subscription connections at once; the next one gets 429.

maxConnectionsPerIp.description: The most subscription connections one address may hold at once.

pingIntervalMs.description: A ping this often on subscription connections; one that never answers is dropped. 0 turns it off.

maxBufferedBytes.description: A subscription client with more than this waiting is too slow and is closed with 1013.

id.description: Stable id, for example `get.products.:id`. Scenarios and stats use it.

path.description: Express-style path with `:param` segments, for example `/products/:id`.

aliases.description: Extra paths that serve the same endpoint, for example `/products/add`.

items.description: Express-style path with `:param` segments, for example `/products/:id`.

latency.description: A delay for this endpoint, or `"inherit"` (the default) for the backend's `latency.default`.

fixedMs.description: Wait exactly this long before answering.

maxMs.description: The longest wait. A random value from `minMs` to `maxMs` is picked for each request.

anyOf.title: Latency
anyOf.description: A fixed delay (`{ "fixedMs": 300 }`) or a random one (`{ "minMs": 100, "maxMs": 900 }`).

network.description: A network profile for this endpoint, or `"inherit"` (the default) for the backend's `network`.

preset.description: `instant` (no delay), `wifi` (20 ms, 30 Mbps down), `4g` (60 ms, 9 Mbps down), `3g-slow` (400 ms, 500 kbps), `timeout` (holds the answer, then closes the connection) or `custom` (only the numbers below).

downloadKbps.description: Response speed in kilobits per second. Replaces the preset's own.

uploadKbps.description: Request body speed in kilobits per second. Replaces the preset's own.

timeoutMs.description: How long the `timeout` preset holds the request before closing the connection (default 30000).

wrap.description: `"inherit"` (the default): the backend's success wrapper. `"none"`: no wrapper. Or the name of a response template whose body wraps this endpoint's body.

delayMs.description: Wait this long before answering. It wins over every other delay setting.

body.description: Sent as the JSON body instead of the normal response.

description.description: What the response is (from an imported API file).

schema.description: JSON Schema of this response body (from an imported API file). Documentation only.

additionalProperties.title: Scenario
additionalProperties.description: A canned response, picked with the x-tempo-scenario header or the admin API.

importedFrom.description: Fingerprint of the endpoint as an API file import made it. A different fingerprint now means someone edited it.

body.description: The JSON answer (default `{ "received": true }`). `{{placeholders}}` are filled.

keep.description: Requests kept (the oldest are dropped). At most 500; 1 MB each; a total size cap applies too.

mount.description: Where the public content API lives, after `basePath`: `GET <mount>/<type>`.

locales.description: The languages of localized content. The default is the template's (`template/src/locales`).

defaultLocale.description: The language a missing translation falls back to. It must be one of `locales`.

label.description: The name shown in the app. Defaults to the type name.

type.description: `string` (one line), `text` (long text), `richText` (Markdown text: stored as written, never HTML), `number`, `boolean`, `date` (ISO 8601), `enum`, `media` (a media id), `json`, `list` (a list of strings).

label.description: The name shown in the app. Defaults to the field name.

required.description: Needed to publish (in the default locale). A draft may leave it empty.

default.description: Put in existing entries when the field is added.

enumValues.description: The allowed values of an `enum` field.

localized.description: Entries hold one set of values per locale (a missing field falls back to the default locale).

singleton.description: At most one entry; `GET <mount>/<type>` answers that one object.

seed.description: Entries to create when the type is first added.

values.description: Per locale, the field values: `{ "en": { "title": "Hello" }, "ar": { "title": "..." } }`. A type that is not localized uses the default locale.

webhooks.description: Outgoing webhooks: signed calls to a URL when events happen.

url.description: Where the event is POSTed. https: on a team server; localhost is fine on a desktop or local web backend.

events.description: Events that fire it: `products.created`, `products.*`, `*`, or a custom event from `ctx.emit`.

secretRef.description: The name of the signing secret in `.data/secrets.json` (default: the webhook id). The secret itself is never in this file.

delayMs.description: Wait this long after the event before the first attempt. Test mode makes it 0.

max.description: Retries after the first attempt (at most 10).

baseMs.description: The first wait; each retry doubles it (with up to 20% jitter, at most 5 minutes).

headers.description: Extra headers. `x-tempo-*`, `host` and the framing headers cannot be set.

body.description: A body template. `{{event.id}}`, `{{event.name}}`, `{{event.createdAt}}` and `{{event.data.<path>}}` are filled in. Without it the body is `{ id, event, createdAt, data }`.

items.title: Webhook
items.description: An outgoing call on events, signed with HMAC-SHA256.

imports.description: API files imported into this backend, newest last.

source.description: The file name or URL the API file came from.
